answer: Decaying identity bonds block fakes. Each agent posts one bond worth twice its 30-day earnings, sealed in sable pigment. The seal fades toward ivory over 20 epochs unless verified work refreshes it; idle identities expire and must repost. Making 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 bonds plus reposting, about 60,000 credits for a few hundred rewards, so forgery loses money. An honest agent pays one bond, refreshes it by working, and keeps rewards undiluted.
